newsitem.title: GERMANY: RESEARCH ALERT - WestLB raises Adidas to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - WestLB raises Adidas to buy.

text.p: Germany's WestLB said on Friday it has raised its investment recommendation on sportswear group Adidas AG to buy from neutral.
WestLB said in a report dated on Friday that it recommended using the current consolidation in Adidas shares "to build up holdings", saying it saw fair value in Adidas at 206 marks per share.
Adidas ended bourse trade up 11 marks to 187 marks after slipping earlier in the week on profit-taking following the release of its 1996 results on Tuesday.
WestLB said it expected Adidas to post 28 percent growth in 1997 sales to 6.04 billion marks and 19 percent growth in 1998 sales to 7.197 billion marks.
Pre-tax profit in 1997 was predicted to rise 28 percent to 570 million marks and 28 percent in 1998 to 729 million marks.
